notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): The three mod.rs files are mostly module plumbing/re-exports, but world/mod.rs carries the wire-visible world handshake contract: SMSG_AUTH_CHALLENGE (plaintext) -> CMSG_AUTH_SESSION -> header encryption switches on -> SMSG_AUTH_RESPONSE -> CMSG_CHAR_ENUM -> CMSG_PLAYER_LOGIN, with 4-byte server / 6-byte client encrypted headers. MSUI implements the full handshake, the header cipher (ported from benilla-srp vanilla_header) and the framing.
